init_AllScAIPConfigs: create an AllScAIPConfigs dataclass instance with nested GlobalConfigs, MolecularGraphConfigs, GNN, and Regularization sub-configs
init_configs: initialize a nested dataclass config tree from a flat kwargs dictionary with automatic default resolution
create_GlobalConfigs: create a GlobalConfigs dataclass to set model hyperparameters like hidden_size, num_layers, activation, and force regression flags
create_MolecularGraphConfigs: create a MolecularGraphConfigs dataclass to configure KNN graph construction, cutoff radius, chunking, and distance functions
resolve_type_hint: resolve a forward reference string type hint to its actual class object for a given dataclass field
